title: some rdp-credssp fixes
description:
This fixes dissection of rdp connections from both windows and freerdp clients, including dissection of the inner gssapi blobs, however I'm still unclear how to to it correctly, especially the last commit - help welcome :)
I'll upload sample captures soon.

notes.body:
[ws-cssp.tgz](/uploads/bb492d65bdcb4dccc71c498da9907d3b/ws-cssp.tgz)

Attached captures and keys here meanwhile.

IIRC `errorCode` and `clientNonce` highly depend on the `version` field, they will be present only in version 5 or 6 (can't remember when it happened). So probably we shall not try to read them with low version numbers.

Indeed they are version dependent, as per:
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-cssp/6aac4dea-08ef-47a6-8747-22ea7f6d8685

As they are optional, the old blobs are still being parsed properly, I can try to make it more strict though by reporting an error if the the fields appear in old versions.
Added a fixup commit to limit errorCode and clientNonce dissection to respective versions.
btw, another todo would be to decrypt the authInfo using the negotiated SPNEGO key (in dissect_credssp_T_authInfo()).

commits_data.message:
credssp: add support for gss-api and krb5 dissection

Since the gssapi handler can cope fine with ntlm blobs, remove the
heuristic in ntlmssp and call the gssapi dissector directly. In turn
we get kerberos support, including decpryption with keytab etc.

commits_data.title: credssp: fix dissection in RDP stream
commits_data.message:
credssp: fix dissection in RDP stream

When there are more packets on the stream after credssp, like tpkt-rpd
data, the credssp heuristics fails when invoked by tls and then even the
packets for which the credssp heuristics succeeded do not get dissected
as credssp but as tpkt-continuation data.
To work around that, call the credssp heuristic dissector directly from
the rdp dissector before trying fastpath.
Leave the credssp heursitics in TLS for other protocols such as HTTP
where it may work.

rdp: add basic dissection of fastpath PDUs

See MS-RDPBCGR 5.4.4 Packet Layout in the I/O Data Stream
